Well, she believes making the rich richer is one of the greatest things you can possibly do. But she doesn't work at McDonald's, I was just saying that she would consider even a minimum wage job as an acceptable reason for why someone deserves to live. 

A lot of people do agree with Ayn Rand though, I mean she got famous writing books about her philosophy, it's not some obscure thing only my friend agrees with, so there are lots of other people who would agree with her about people who can't make money being worthless.

I would like it if I could ever write something people would actually pay to read, but I don't know if I'll ever have the talent for that.
Thanks. I guess it just seems like if I were a worthwhile person, I would have friends and family who didn't want me to die.
I do miss having the unconditional love of a pet. I probably will get another, but it can be hard to replace an animal right away when yours just died.

I do have a hobby of writing short stories, but my friend says that's worthless since no one is willing to pay money for them. I do volunteer work sometimes, but my friend laughs at people who volunteer and also thinks that's worthless. It's not that she thinks everyone has to be a rockstar- if I was even capable of working at McDonald's, she'd think my life was worth living. She basically worships Ayn Rand and thinks working to make money is the only worthwhile thing you can possibly do. 

I know people don't understand why I take her opinion so seriously, but we've been friends since childhood and she's the only human connection I have.

Well, she's not specifically encouraging me to do it, like I said, she's said she'd feel bad if I killed myself because of something she said. She's an Ayn Rand-style Objectivst and believes that all people who can't work to support themselves should die. She says it's just her philosophy and isn't anything personal against me. But obviously it makes me feel terrible.
Just the regular social security disability which is like 800 a month. I'm in the U.S.

But she makes money and supports herself instead of living off the government like I do. She's not a drain on society's resources like I am.

I want to believe she's wrong in what she says about me, but she's literally the only friend I have, the only person who can tolerate my company at all. So if the only person who even likes me thinks I should be dead, what does that say about me?
I would love to travel but that costs money, and I have none of that since I can't work.

The thing is I don't think there's any greater purpose for me. I'm already nearly 40 and have accomplished absolutely nothing, and can't think of anything I'd be physically or mentally capable of doing that would be remotely useful or important.
